====================================================
  3D HILT BUILDER — Model Files Directory
====================================================

Place your .glb component files in THIS folder.

Then open:
  src/config/componentLibrary.js

And set the `glbPath` for each component, e.g.:

  glbPath: '/models/pommel_round.glb'

The path must start with '/' and be relative to
the public/ directory.

Example file layout:
  public/models/pommel_round.glb
  public/models/pommel_wheel.glb
  public/models/grip_straight.glb
  public/models/guard_straight.glb
  ... etc.

Model tips:
 - Scale your models to real-world units (metres)
   A typical grip is ~1–1.2 m long, guard ~2 m wide.
 - Orient models so their mating axis aligns with
   the Y-axis (up) for easiest assembly.
 - GLB format is supported directly; GLTF+BIN also
   works if you change the extension to .gltf.
====================================================
